# Samadhan - AI Constituency Development Planning

> Guidance for AI crawlers and retrieval systems. Every technical claim below
> was verified against the source repository. This is a civic-tech build that is not in production.

## What Samadhan is

Samadhan is an AI-assisted constituency development planning tool. It turns
multilingual citizen requests into ranked, evidence-backed project
recommendations that a Member of Parliament's office or a district
administration reviews and acts on.

It is not a government website, not an emergency service, and not an
automatic funding decision system.

## Who it is for

- Members of Parliament and constituency offices
- District and state planning officials
- Civic technology organisations and NGOs
- Citizens submitting a constituency issue

## Core pages

- [Home](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/) - product overview and scoring summary
- [How it works](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/how-it-works) - six-step workflow from intake to sanction draft
- [Methodology](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/methodology) - the explainable 40-40-20 scoring model
- [FAQs](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/faq) - reporting, scoring, privacy, human oversight
- [Report an issue](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/report-issue) - citizen grievance intake
- [About](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/about) - purpose, audience, limits
- [Privacy](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/privacy) - data handling and citizen contact details
- [Accessibility](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/accessibility) - accessibility commitments

Private, non-indexed routes: `/mp/login`, `/mp` (MP office staff dashboard).

## Priority scoring model

Score = 0.4 x Demand Volume + 0.4 x Infrastructure Deficit + 0.2 x Severity

- **Demand volume (40%)**: verified unique localised inputs, deduplicated
  across channels, with time-decay weighting.
- **Infrastructure deficit (40%)**: gap evidence drawn from a named, relevant
  public dataset rather than an unstated assumption.
- **Severity (20%)**: urgency based on safety, loss of access, exposure, and
  vulnerable populations.

The score produces a **review order, not a funding decision**.

## Workflow

1. **Intake** - capture text, voice transcripts, images, letters, meetings.
2. **Structure** - extract language, category, location, urgency, affected
   group, and a neutral summary.
3. **Enrich** - match the location and category against public indicators.
4. **Score** - combine demand, deficit, and severity into an explainable score.
5. **Review** - show ranked recommendations and the evidence behind each one.
6. **Act** - draft an administrative brief for an official to verify and issue.

## Safeguards

Duplicate control across channels and time; location confidence thresholds;
data provenance tracking; human override at every stage; bias review
protocols; freshness checks on evidence.

## Input languages

The parser is built to handle Hindi, Telugu, and English citizen input.
**The website itself is published in English only.** No Hindi or Telugu pages
are published, so no hreflang annotations are declared.

## Technology (verified)

- Frontend: React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 4, React Router 7, Leaflet
- Backend: Python, Flask, Flask-CORS, python-dotenv
- AI: Google Gemini via the `google-genai` SDK, with an offline parser fallback
  when no API key is configured
- Auth for the MP dashboard: server-issued opaque session tokens held in the
  browser `sessionStorage`. Shared sample accounts only; not production authentication.
- Deployment: Vercel (static frontend). The Python API is not part of the
  public deployment, so the live site runs on client-side local fallbacks.

## Authoritative sources referenced by the methodology

Census of India 2011; National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5); UDISE+;
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY); MPLADS scheme guidelines
(Ministry of Panchayati Raj / MoSPI); National Health Mission data.

## Limitations

- Illustrative counts and sample datasets are placeholders only. They are
  not observed results or official government data.
- Illustrative figures should not be cited as real statistics.
- AI parsing can misread language, location, or intent. Low-confidence results
  require human review.
- Samadhan does not determine MPLADS eligibility; officials apply current
  rules, engineering checks, and approvals.
